exercises.instructions: Combine the following sentences using 'so … that'.

questions.question: The box is very heavy. I cannot lift it. Combine using 'so … that'.
options: so heavy that I cannot lift it
very heavy that I cannot lift it
so heavy which I cannot lift it
questions.answer: so heavy that I cannot lift it
questions.explanation: Use 'so + adjective + that + result'. 'Very heavy that' is incorrect. 'So … which' is the wrong conjunction.

options: so hard that he passed the test
very hard that he passed the test
so hard which he passed the test
questions.answer: so hard that he passed the test
questions.explanation: Use 'so + adverb + that + result'. 'Hard' is an adverb here. 'Very … that' is incorrect. 'So … which' is wrong.
